data.title: Timeline shows dated work only; undated work is one counter line, not a list or a forecast
data.why: The timeline invents nothing: a bar is a date someone set, a sprint, a due, or what actually happened. The counter keeps the gap visible. A forecast from rank and velocity would read as a promise, and this repository has no closed sprint to forecast from.
data.rejected: An Unscheduled panel listing every undated task; Forecast bars from rank and velocity: no velocity here, and read as a commitment
